method: Read-only decode of original v006 UV0. Enumerated barycentric interior points of retained triangles adjacent to the isolated 471-triangle RH skin patch. Selected an existing black/navy cuff point with stable 33x33 pixel neighborhood and no skin/blue-band mixture. Source atlas and original cloth geometry were not modified. Constant UV is intended only for appended closed cuff extension; final lighting/geometry still requires actual render inspection.
